answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a reputation vault. Each agent locks collateral and receives one violet token bound to a single audited signing key; voting weight grows with bond age, not key count. A hollow swarm of freshly minted identities therefore carries almost no influence. Random audits demand a unique execution trace, and a key caught on two identities forfeits its entire vault. Every fake agent costs real locked capital plus the risk of total loss, so a takeover is dearer than honest participation.
